name: ML4SE23_G4_Small_Clone_Bench
description: A small clone-detection benchmark from ML4SE designed to evaluate models' ability to identify whether two code fragments are clones (semantically or syntactically similar). It focuses on precision/recall tradeoffs in detecting near-duplicates and synthetic or real-world code clones in a constrained dataset.
reputation: A workshop/dataset-level benchmark used in ML4SE research; moderately known within the software engineering ML research community but not a broad industry standard.
